The daily workflow — how it actually runs
Import your leads — data saves automatically
Use the Import button to paste your CSV. All leads are saved to your browser's local storage — they'll be there every time you open this file. No export needed between sessions.
Filter to "Not contacted" → check 25 leads
Use the status filter to show only untouched leads. The checkboxes let you select any 25. The bulk bar lights up at the bottom.
Click "Copy Batch for Claude" → paste here
One click generates a formatted block for all 25 leads. Paste into this Claude chat. Claude queues all 25 Gmail drafts in under a minute. The batch is logged in Batch History automatically.
Review drafts in Gmail → send
Open Gmail, flip through the drafts, send. Then come back here, select those 25, and bulk-mark them "Email sent." Your progress is saved automatically.
Claude monitors replies + updates statuses
Ask Claude to scan Gmail for replies. It'll update statuses, flag interested leads, and draft follow-ups. All status changes save instantly.
🔗 Gmail Direct Integration — OAuth Setup

Paste your Google OAuth Client ID here to enable the "📤 Send Batch to Gmail Drafts" button. The Client ID is the only credential stored — all authentication happens through Google's own login screen.

Not connected
How to get your Client ID (15 minutes)
Create a Google Cloud project
Go to console.cloud.google.com → New Project → name it "Prestige PEO CRM".
Enable the Gmail API
APIs & Services → Library → search "Gmail API" → Enable.
Configure OAuth consent screen
APIs & Services → OAuth consent screen → External → fill App name "Prestige PEO CRM" → add your email as test user → Save.
Create OAuth credentials
Credentials → Create Credentials → OAuth 2.0 Client ID → Web application. Under Authorized redirect URIs add the exact URL of this HTML file (e.g. file:///C:/Users/you/prestige_peo.html or your hosted URL). Copy the Client ID and paste it above.
Save Client ID → Connect Gmail → You're live
Paste the Client ID above, click Save, then click Connect Gmail. Sign in with your Google account. The "📤 Send Batch to Gmail Drafts" button will now create drafts automatically.

⚠ Important for file:// users: Chrome blocks OAuth redirects to file:// URIs by default. For best results, serve this file locally with a simple server: run npx serve . in its folder, then open http://localhost:3000. Add that URL as the authorized redirect URI instead.
